name: Niriksha
description: Real-time object detection for time-of-flight drones.
detail: Built by HalfBaked Engineers for Hack-o-NiT, Niriksha combines YOLOv8 predictions through ensemble learning. The team reports 84% accuracy in testing. A Flask API serves predictions to a web interface. The system is under active development as part of patent-related research.

name: FileTracker
description: A workspace for uploading, finding, and organizing files.
detail: The file-management dashboard brings uploads, search, tags, and file details into one view.

name: Fabricanova
description: A retrieval-powered design assistant for fashion exploration.
detail: Semantic search selects a product image and metadata. Gemma drafts a design description and Swin2SR enlarges the visual reference.

name: GitRAG
description: Ask questions about a codebase using its Git commit history.
detail: GitPython reads commits into SQLite. MiniLM embeddings and FAISS retrieve relevant changes for Gemma to explain.

name: BankingEnterprise
description: Customer management APIs built with Spring Boot and PostgreSQL.
detail: The customer management module models personal records and addresses with Spring Data JPA and PostgreSQL.
